privacy: Read-only public evaluation assets. Report contains aggregate metrics and sample IDs only; no page pixels, OCR text, or LaTeX labels are emitted.

correction_marks.license: CC BY 4.0 (source stated; review before redistribution)
correction_marks.scope: English university exams; correction-mark/layout evaluation only, not Chinese K-9 OCR.
correction_marks.candidate_boundary: Components are change-derived red-ink candidates, not ground-truth tick/cross/circle labels.

mathwriting.scope: 500 rendered InkML formulas; not proof of photographed-homework accuracy.
mathwriting.metric_boundary: Structure is strict normalized LaTeX token equality, not symbolic mathematical equivalence.

chinese_handwriting_smoke.license: non-commercial research/sample-only; full datasets require application.
chinese_handwriting_smoke.scope: Five public Chinese handwriting images for smoke testing only; no Chinese handwriting accuracy claim.

family_document_camera.scope: Required separate Nanjing K-9/high-camera benchmark; no family images are included in this shared pack.
